Name: Nuclear Valley Tweaks
Author: qasdxzaq
Description:
Makes the buildings from Nuclear Valley significantly more difficult to get.

Requires:
Nuclear Valley ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23339]PG[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40779]R[/url])
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23732]Quonset Barn[/url]

The primary change is gating the Atomic Research Silo behind 5 radioactive bars, because having infinite radioactive ore early game felt too overpowered to me.

It also moves the Quonset Barn to be in Anabelle's build menu, rather than Robin's.
